description: 高级句型结构汇总，用于评估句式复杂度和给出改进建议

patterns.pattern: Not only ... but also ... (部分倒装)
patterns.template: Not only does/did + 主语 + 动词, but (主语) also + 动词
patterns.example: Not only does this trend reflect social progress, but it also indicates people's changing attitudes.
common_errors: 忘记倒装——Not only this trend reflects...
but also 后面也倒装（错误）

patterns.pattern: Only + 状语 + 部分倒装
patterns.template: Only by/when/through ... can/will/do + 主语 + 动词
patterns.example: Only by taking effective measures can we solve this problem.
common_errors: Only后面的从句倒装了（应该主句倒装）

patterns.template: Neither/Nor + 助动词 + 主语
patterns.example: The urban population increased, and nor did the trend show any sign of slowing down.

patterns.template: So + adj./adv. + 助动词 + 主语 + that ...
patterns.example: So rapid was the growth that the number doubled in just five years.
common_errors: so后面接名词（应用such）

patterns.template: It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 其余部分
patterns.example: It is the convenience of online shopping that accounts for its popularity.
common_errors: 强调人时用that而非who（两者皆可但who更好）
忘记that

patterns.template: What + 主语 + 动词 + is/was + 名词/从句
patterns.example: What the chart reveals is a significant shift in people's lifestyle choices.
common_errors: What从句做主语时谓语单复数错误

patterns.pattern: do/does/did + 动词原形（强调谓语）
patterns.template: 主语 + do/does/did + 动词原形
patterns.example: The data does indicate a growing awareness of health among young people.
common_errors: does后面接了动词三单形式

patterns.pattern: If + 过去式, 主语 + would/could + 动词原形
patterns.template: 与现在事实相反的假设
patterns.example: If more attention were paid to environmental protection, the situation would be much better.
common_errors: be动词在虚拟语气中统一用were
would后面接了过去式

patterns.pattern: 建议类动词 + that + (should) + 动词原形
patterns.template: suggest/recommend/advise/propose + that + sb. + (should) + do
patterns.example: I suggest that the government (should) invest more in education.
common_errors: that从句中用了动词三单形式

patterns.pattern: It is essential/vital/necessary that + (should) + 动词原形
patterns.template: It is + adj. + that + sb. + (should) + do
patterns.example: It is essential that immediate measures (should) be taken to address this issue.
common_errors: 从句中用了普通谓语形式

patterns.template: 主句, which + 对前面整个句子或先行词的补充说明
patterns.example: The number of visitors reached 1 million in 2020, which represented a 50% increase.
common_errors: 非限制性定语从句中用了that（应用which）
缺少逗号

patterns.template: 先行词（地点/时间）, where/when + 从句
patterns.example: The year 2015 saw a major turning point, when the percentage exceeded 50% for the first time.

patterns.pattern: 现在分词作状语（表伴随/原因/结果）
patterns.template: Doing ..., 主语 + 谓语 / 主语 + 谓语, doing ...
patterns.example: Considering the rapid development of technology, it is not surprising that online education has become popular.
common_errors: 悬垂分词——分词的逻辑主语与句子主语不一致

patterns.template: Done/Given/Compared ..., 主语 + 谓语
patterns.example: Compared with the data in 2010, the figure in 2020 showed a remarkable increase.
common_errors: 过去分词和现在分词用混

patterns.template: The fact/idea/notion/belief + that + 陈述句
patterns.example: The fact that more people are choosing to exercise regularly is encouraging.
common_errors: 同位语从句和定语从句混淆
that不能省略

patterns.pattern: with + 名词 + doing/done/adj./介词短语
patterns.template: With + n. + 补足语, 主句
patterns.example: With the economy developing rapidly, people's living standards have improved significantly.
common_errors: with后面接了完整句子
补足语形式选择错误

patterns.pattern: It is + adj. + to do / that ...
patterns.template: It is evident/obvious/clear/apparent that ...
patterns.example: It is evident from the chart that there has been a steady increase in online shopping.

patterns.template: It is + adv. + p.p. + that ...
patterns.example: It is widely acknowledged that education plays a crucial role in social development.

patterns.template: 毫无疑问/不可否认...
patterns.example: There is no denying that technology has profoundly changed the way we live.
common_errors: denying后面没接that从句

patterns.template: 存在...
patterns.example: There remain several issues that need to be addressed.
common_errors: remain后面主谓不一致
